translation.name: Mushog Testamento
translation.englishName: Huamalíes-Dos de Mayo Huánuco Quechua NT

content: Jesucristuta Zaqueo wayinman chasquicushgan
Jericó marcachömi targan Zaqueo jutiyog rïcu runa. Paymi cargan impuesto cobragcunapa mandagnin. Sauraga Jericó marcapa asca runacunawan Jesús päsaptinmi tacshala car ricayta puëdergansu.
Saymi Jesús päsaycagta ricananpä cörrila aywar Zaqueo wisacurcorgan sicómoro gueruman.
Saypa päsaycashgancho Zaqueuta ricärir Jesús nergan: “Zaqueo, jucla urämuy. Wayiquimanmi aywaycä posädasimänayquipä.”
Sayno niptinmi Zaqueo jucla urarcur Jesusta cushish pushargan wayinman.
Sayta ricaycur lapan runacuna Jesusta jamuräyargan: “¿Imanirtä jusasapa runapa wayinman aywaycan posädacunanpä?” nir.
Wayinchöna caycarmi Jesusta Zaqueo nergan: “Sararashgäpita pulantami imätapis muchogcunata raquipaycushä, taytay. Sayno pipa imantapis guechushgäpita chuscu cuti mastami cutisishä.”
Sayno niptin Jesús nergan: “Cananga salvashganami caycanqui gampis y wayiquicho tagcunapis. Abraham yäracushgannömi gampis Tayta Diosninsiman yäracuycanqui.
Jusasapa runacunata salvanäpämi Tayta Diosninsi nogata cachamash.”
Ashmaynincuna aruyänanpä patronnin guellayta puestupashgan

Jerusalenman Jesús aywaycaptinnami runacuna yarpäyargan sayman chaycuptin jucla rey cananpä payta churayänanpä cashganta. Yarpäyashganno mana cananpä cashganta tantyasinanpämi Jesús quiquin tincusicorgan rïcu runaman:
“Juc rïcu runashi aywargan juclä nacionman mandag cayta chasquimunanpä.
Manarä aywarshi gayasergan chunca (10) ashmaynincunata. Nircur jucnintapis jucnintapis ayporgan asca guellayta: ‘Cutimushgäyag cay guellaywan aruycäyanqui’ nir.
Sayno nir aywacuptin marca mayincuna payta chiquiyashpan guepanta comisionta cachayargan: ‘Manami say runata mandagnë rey cananpä munayäsu’ niyänanpä.
“Sayno marca mayincuna mana munaycaptinpis mandag cayta chasquergan. Saypita marcanman cutiycurnashi gayasergan guellaynin sararag ashmaynincunata guellaynin aycata wachashgantapis musyananpä.
Sayshi puntata shamog cag nergan: ‘Guellayniqui mirash gomashgayquipita chunca (10) cuti mastami, taytay.’
Saymi mandagnin nergan: ‘¡Ali ashmaymi gam canqui! Walcalapitapis shumag guellayta mirasishgayquipitami chunca (10) marcapa mandagnin canayquipä churashayqui.’
Jucagpis shamur nergan: ‘Guellayniqui mirash gomashgayquipita pisga cuti mastami, taytay.’
Paytapis nergan: ‘Pisga marcapa mandagnin canayquipämi gamta churashayqui.’
“Saynöpis jucag ashmaynin shamur nergan: ‘Caycho caycan guellayniqui, taytay. Pañuëluwan guepircurmi churaycorgä.
Gamga shuntanqui mana churashgayquipita y cosechanqui mana murushgayquipitami. Sayno fiyu cashgayquita musyarmi churaycorgä.’

Sayshi patronnin nergan: ‘¡Gamga mana yäracuypä ashmaymi canqui! Quiquiquipa shimilayquipitami juzgashayqui. Fiyu cashgäta musyaycar, mana churaycar shuntashgäta musyaycar y mana muruycar cosechashgätapis musyaycarga ¿imanirtä banculamanpis churargayquisu mirashtana cutimur shuntacunäpä?’
Sayshi nergan saycho caycag runacunata: ‘¡Guechuyay sararaycashgan guellaynëta! ¡Nircur goycuyay chunca (10) cuti más guellay miraseg cagta!’
Sayno niptinshi niyargan: ‘Payga maynami sararaycan chunca (10) cuti masta, taytay.’
Niptinshi patronnin nergan: ‘Guellayta puestupashgäta mirasegcunaga mastami chasquiyanga. Mana mirasegcunami isanga sararashgalantapis guechushga cayanga.
Mandagnin canäta mana munar chiquimagnëcunataga ¡cayman apaycamur wanusiyay noga ricaycaptë!’ ”
Jerusalenman Jesucristo yaycuptin runacuna alabayashgan
Sayno wilaparcurmi Jerusalenpa Jesús aywacorgan.
Olivos lömacho cag Betania y Betfagé nishgan marcacunaman chaycarna ishcay discïpuluncunata puntata cachargan:
“Aywayay Betfagé marcaman. Charnami tariyanquipä pipis manarä muntacushgan ashnu wataraycagta. Sayta pascarir apayämunqui.
Saycho pipis: ‘Ashnöta ¿imanirtä pascaycäyanqui?’ niyäshuptiquega: ‘Jesusmi munaycan muntacunanpä’ niyanqui.”
Sayno cachaptinmi discïpuluncuna aywar tariyargan Jesús nishgannöla.
Saypita ashnuta pascaycäyaptinmi ämun taporgan: “¿Imanirtä ashnöta pascaycäyanqui?” nir.
Sayno niptinmi niyargan: “Jesusmi munaycan muntacunanpä.”
Saymi ashnuta janchacurcur Jesús caycashgan cagman cutiyargan. Saychönami punchuncunata carunarcur saripäyargan Jesús muntacunanpä.
Muntash aywaptinnami runacuna cushicuyashpan jacuncunata punchuncunata aywaycashgan näniman mashtayargan.
Olivos lömapa uraycäyaptinnami gatiragnincuna cushicur Diosta alabayargan lapan milagrucunata ricayashganpita:
“¡Tayta Diosninsi cachamushgan mandamagninsi rey caychönami caycan! ¡Tayta Diosninsi imayyagpis alabash cayculäsun!” niyashpan.
Saymi saycho caycag fariseucuna runacunapa chaupinpita niyargan: “Olgutupay gatiräshogniquicuna upälacuyänanpä, taytay.”
Sayno niyaptinmi Jesús nergan: “Paycuna upälacuyaptenga rumicunapis Tayta Diosninsita alabayangami.”
Saypitami Jerusalén marcata ricärir saycho tag runacunapä Jesús wagargan:
“Ali cawayta apamushgäta canan junaglapis tantyarga alimi cawayanquiman. Sayno caycaptinpis manami tantyayanquisu.
Saymi gamcunapä chämonga nacayänayquipä cag junagcuna. Chiquishogniquicuna jiruruypa sapäyäshuptiquega manami maypapis gueshpiyanquipänasu.

Saypita marcaman yaycur atacashushpayqui wamrantintami wanusiyäshunquipä. Wayiquicunatapis chipyagmi juchusir ushayangapä. Manami ni juc rumilapis pergaraycar quëdangapäsu. Saynömi canga Tayta Diosninsi salvayäshunayquipä shamushganta mana cäsucuyashgayquipita.”
Templo patiucho ranticogcunata Jesucristo gargushgan
Jerusalenman Jesús chaycurnami templo patiuman yaycuycur saycho ranticuycagcunata gargorgan.

Gargurmi paycunata nergan: “Tayta Diosninsipa palabranchöga caynömi guelgaraycan: ‘Templöga canga nogata manacayämänanpämi.’ Sayno guelgaraycaptenga ¿imanirtä gamcuna ticrasiyashcanqui suwacunapa machayninmanno?”
Nircurnami templo patiucho waran waran Jesús yachasergan. Saymi mandag cüracuna, Moisés guelgashganta yachasegcuna y autoridäcunapis wilanacuyargan Jesusta imanöpapis wanusiyänanpä.
Lapan runacuna Jesús yachasishganta shumag wiyaptinmi ima ruraytapis camäpacuyargansu.

footnotes.text: Say wisan costumbri cashganno marcaman juc rey yaycuptin runacuna cushish chasquicorga jacuncunata, punchuncunata y palmatapis näniman mashtapäyag.
